name: Exp_StochasticDiff
summary: This EA trades based on the StochasticDiff custom indicator, which applies an additional smoothing algorithm to the Stochastic Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed Stochastic value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标StochasticDiff进行交易，该指标对随机振荡器应用额外的平滑算法。当平滑后的随机值向上拐头时开多仓，向下拐头时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于对传统随机振荡器的差异化处理：先计算标准Stochastic指标，再对其结果应用用户可选的平滑算法（如T3、JJMA、JurX等），从而过滤噪音并提取趋势动量方向。入场条件为：当平滑后的Stochastic值连续上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当连续下降（Value[0]<=Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓，本质是捕捉动量拐点。出场条件依赖反向信号平仓，同时也设置了固定的止损和止盈（默认1000和2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，但缺乏对市场波动率、点差和流动性的过滤。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a differentiated treatment of the traditional Stochastic Oscillator: it first calculates the standard Stochastic indicator and then applies a user-selectable smoothing algorithm (such as T3, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to filter noise and extract trend momentum direction. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the smoothed Stochastic value turns upward (Value[0]>=Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position opens when it turns downward (Value[0]<=Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]), essentially capturing momentum inflection points. Exit conditions rely on opposite signals for position closing, while also setting fixed stop loss and take profit levels (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively). Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, free margin after loss percentage, balance after loss percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 (10% risk). The strategy also uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, avoiding repeated trades, but lacks filters for market volatility, spread, and liquidity.

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description_en: Smoothing phase (-100~+100 for JJMA, different for VIDYA/AMA)

pros: 利用多种高级平滑算法过滤Stochastic噪音，信号质量优于原生Stochastic
支持五种仓位管理模式，资金管理灵活
买卖方向可独立开关，便于单向交易或对冲策略
新K线检测机制避免同一K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数完备，风险可控
pros_en: Uses multiple advanced smoothing algorithms to filter Stochastic noise, yielding higher quality signals than raw Stochastic
Supports five position sizing modes for flexible money management
Buy and sell directions can be independently enabled/disabled, facilitating unidirectional or hedging strategies
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trades within the same bar
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters for controllable risk
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能导致不必要的交易成本
没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
默认止损1000点和止盈2000点过大，不适合小周期交易
依赖自定义指标StochasticDiff，增加了部署和维护复杂度
没有动态止损机制如移动止损或保本止损
cons_en: Lacks spread filter, which may lead to unnecessary trading costs in high-spread environments
No position check mechanism; may open duplicate positions in the same direction
Default SL of 1000 and TP of 2000 points are too large for smaller timeframes
Depends on the custom StochasticDiff indicator, increasing deployment and maintenance complexity
No dynamic stop loss mechanism such as trailing stop or breakeven stop
improvements: 添加点差过滤和最大点差限制，避免高成本交易
增加持仓检查逻辑，防止同方向重复开仓
实现移动止损或保本止损机制，锁定浮动利润
improvements_en: Add spread filter and maximum spread limit to avoid high-cost trades
Add position check logic to prevent duplicate entries in the same direction
Implement trailing stop or breakeven stop mechanism to lock in floating profits

risk_points: 缺乏同向持仓检查可能导致重复开仓放大风险
固定的止损止盈无法适应不同市场波动环境
没有点差过滤在极端市场条件下可能产生滑点损失
risk_points_en: Lack of same-direction position check may cause duplicate entries amplifying risk
Fixed stop loss and take profit cannot adapt to varying market volatility conditions
No spread filter may cause slippage losses under extreme market conditions
